research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Shared resource allocation for multiple queue processing describes allocating remote agents across multiple queues at different locations, such as agents taking orders at a restaurant. The abstract explains how agents are dynamically assigned among queues to process user requests efficiently. Bite Ninja is researching and developing systems for remote agent management, multi queue request handling, and shared resource allocation for restaurant order processing and related services.

about_short_description.short_description: Bite Ninja is a remote hiring technology platform for restaurants.

product.name: Bite Ninja Remote Labor Platform
product.description: A web-based platform that enables restaurants to staff drive-thru and front counter positions remotely by connecting remote order-takers with restaurant POS and communication systems.

product.name: NinjaQ Queueing Technology
product.description: A queue management system that enables remote cashiers to serve multiple restaurant locations by detecting customer arrivals and assigning orders to available remote workers.

product.name: Ninja Workforce Pool
product.description: A pool of vetted freelance remote order-takers (Ninjas) with restaurant or retail experience available to restaurants for on-demand staffing of remote cashier shifts.

product.name: Shinobi Secure Remote Access Software
product.description: A proprietary software that allows remote workers to access a restaurant’s existing POS system securely without requiring direct API integration or development work.
